description: NaLiNiPO₄F crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.66 Å. There is one shorter (2.45 Å) and one longer (2.61 Å) Na-F bond length. Li is bonded to three O and one F atom to form distorted LiO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 68-82°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.05 Å. The Li-F bond length is 1.92 Å. Ni is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form NiO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₃F tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NiO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.08 Å. There is one shorter (2.07 Å) and one longer (2.09 Å) Ni-F bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with three equivalent LiO₃F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ni and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one P atom. F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and two equivalent Ni atoms.
